load.multiHint: Select the model AND its textures together — a .gltf needs its .bin, an .obj needs its .mtl.

source.title: Source
source.unitGuessed: Not stated by the file — guessed from the size of the model. Change it if it came in wrong.
source.upAxisDeclared: glTF always stores Y up, so there is nothing to choose.

placement.title: Placement
placement.hint: The model starts centred on the IFC, sitting on its floor. Nothing here moves the IFC.

error.noEntryFile: No GLB, glTF or OBJ in that selection.
error.parseFailed: That model could not be read.
error.budgetExhausted: The triangle budget is full. Remove a model before adding another.

demos.title: Sample models
demos.hint: Real public models, fetched straight into your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
demos.failed: That sample could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.

items.box: The smallest thing that can work — twelve triangles, no textures. If this one fails, the problem is not your file.
items.duckDraco: Draco-compressed geometry across three files. It declares Draco as required, so it cannot open at all without a decoder — and its texture is found by name out of the same selection.
items.helmet: A textured PBR model in one self-contained file. Also a lesson in why the triangle and texture budgets exist: five 2K maps from a 3.8 MB download.
items.humanFigure: Imports WRONG on purpose. It is in centimetres and standing up, so both the unit and the up-axis guesses miss — fix them with the two controls below and watch it land.
